    Weight-homogeneous lifts of the evaluated modules (Proposition 10.1) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "All these constructions can be chosen to preserve the simultaneous integer weights: lifting a basis of H_ℤ to mesh weights by Lemma 7.4 gives the modules M_i⁽²⁾ compatible weight gradings, and the corrections can be chosen in each weight component."

    A mesh weight W of C⁽²⁾ with values in an abelian group M grades A⁽²⁾ and the evaluated modules (grA0, grEv, WeightEv.lean). When it lifts the ray weights hv of the table P (the rays Θ(b_r) are homogeneous of weight hv r, hΘ), each integer coordinate φ : M →+ ℤ grades A⁽²⁾ (galgW), A⁽⁴⁾ = 𝒪P (galgOW, by the ray weights) and the modules (gwEv), compatibly with the reduction (isRedW), the actions (actW), the degree and each other. Then the module lifts and arrow lifts of Proposition 10.1 can be chosen homogeneous for any finite family of coordinates (exists_modLiftW, exists_arrowLiftW), by exists_liftMod_weights and exists_liftHom_weights.
